title.zh: 轨道运动 · 椭圆、速度与凌日

desc.zh: 从恒星所在的焦点出发，用同一个两体引力模型推出开普勒三定律：扫过相等面积、近日点更快、周期随半长轴的 3/2 次方增长；再算行星凌日让星光暗多少、持续多久、为什么很少能看到。
desc.en: Start from the star at one focus and use one two-body gravity model to derive Kepler’s three laws: equal areas, a faster perihelion and a period that grows as the 3/2 power of the orbit; then work out how much a transit dims the star, how long it lasts and why most systems never show one.
